svg.text: Direct imports, from go list. An arrow points from the importer to the imported package; colours follow the groups of the package table.
Left out: internal/config (the schema and pins), which nearly every package imports, and internal/redact (endpoint and error
redaction), which config, orchestrator, serverstats, calibrate, cmd/naivesweep and cmd/percentes-calibrate import. Test-only:
internal/ac (the SPEC.md §8 acceptance suite) and internal/hostqual (the host probe its timing-coupled tests run first). loadgen
imports mock for the loopback canary; validity imports run, and run does not import validity; report imports campaign and
validity to render the run and campaign report pairs.
